text: The eccentric scientist Seth Brundle shows the science journalist Ronnie Quaife his [telepods|images|household objects and machines], machines that teleport objects but turn a baboon inside out. They become lovers, and one night, embittered by jealousy, Seth [teleports himself alone|trigger|playing god], unaware that a fly has slipped into the pod with him. He emerges stronger and more potent, until bristly hairs sprout from his back, his fingernails fall out and [his body begins to come apart|threat|the body turning monstrous], while Ronnie learns that [she is pregnant|who_suffers|expectant parents].
